signature.analysis: posthoc; all original outcomes previously observed
signature.normalization: Fixed test hidden RMS around true-intermediate mean; diagnostics only. Margin ratios restricted to oracle-correct inputs.
signature.primary_contrast: both_correct minus both_wrong; use source means, not six independent sources
signature.scope: Real intermediates and labels used only for diagnosis, not inference or hyperparameter choice; nullspace preserves linear logits, not all answer information.
